o.text: From Proto-Turkic *baĺmak (“boot, shoe”). Compare Tatar башмак (başmaq, “shoe”), dialectal Turkish başmak (“shoe”).
Borrowed from Russian каранда́ш (karandáš), from a Turkic language. Equivalent to qara + daş.
